id.description: Stable identifier for this actor, with a required namespace (for example base:gagaa).

name.description: Display name shown in the editor and game.

icon.description: Icon identifier used to represent this actor in the editor.

emotions.description: List of emotion IDs available for this actor in dialogue line nodes.

folderPath.description: Virtual folder path for workspace organization (e.g. 'NPCs/Villagers'). Empty string or absent = root.
